decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service builds on the firm's existing data infrastructure and costs little to keep running, so it remains a cheap option that supports the platform strategy.
The Austrian gas grid fee database extends a core database competence into a new market whose value is still uncertain, and keeping it costs little, so the option is worth holding.
Peak load window determination is a regulated, recurring calculation service close to the core business, with low carrying cost and steady demand from network operators.
The end-customer tariff database is a multi-model product line central to the firm's market data offering, and it fits the move toward a fuller platform model.
Custom web services are a flexible, demand-driven offer that costs almost nothing to keep available and generates project revenue.
The postal code lookup service reuses the firm's established address and grid data, so its maintenance cost is minimal while it adds value to the web service portfolio.
